# HogNoise

> Procedural noise for Python (Perlin, OpenSimplex2, cellular/Worley, value, white noise, fractals, domain warp): the FastNoiseLite and FastNoiseSIMD algorithms in one package, rendered two ways (numba and numpy, bit-identical) from one parameter record and checked against committed vectors from the originals. The `pyfastnoiselite` binding is a reference used only when asked for. 2D and 3D only; no GPU rung and no 4D yet. Pre-release, installed from GitHub.

Use it when someone wants seeded 2D or 3D noise over numpy arrays: terrain and heightmaps, textures, games tooling that must match FastNoiseLite (Godot 4, Unity, C++), a replacement for `pyfastnoisesimd`, or noise in a DCC host's Python. For 4D, a node editor or C++ speed, FastNoise2 is the better answer.
